name: jvm_coverage_run
title: jvm.coverage_run
description: Run the project test suite under coverage instrumentation in a container. Measures the REPO’S OWN suite — the point is to reflect the project’s actual testing discipline, not a synthetic one. The report is AGGREGATE over the whole run: JaCoCo’s agent writes one exec dump at JVM exit, so a line marked covered was reached by SOME test, not by any identified one. Do not compute a per-test executed subgraph from it.

outputSchema.description: Describes the `data` payload ONLY. The envelope { ok, evidenceId, data | unknown } is universal and enforced by modules/mcpserver.

testsRun.description: Parsed from the build output when the format is recognised. ABSENT when it could not be parsed — a number is never invented to fill the field.
